about: Zino Platinum is the high-end Zino brand Davidoff launched in 2002, rolled in the Dominican Republic. It is sold as two families, the Scepter Series and the Crown Series, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over a Connecticut binder and Dominican and Peruvian filler.
notes: Platinum is a family (Scepter and Crown Series), not one cigar; specs are the core blend, and limited editions use other blends. Retailers list it as medium; a 2004 Cigar Aficionado note calls the Scepter mild to medium. The maker's Zino site now lists only Nicaragua and Honduras, so it may no longer be made.
verifyNotes: Strength changed from Mild-Medium to Medium: Famous Smoke lists Medium for both Scepter sizes, Luxury Cigar Club's spec line says Medium, and Cigar Aficionado's 2006 Crown Chubby Especial rating (ratings/10929) says Medium; only CA's 2004 tasting note says mild to medium-bodied. Removed the Scepter Low Rider 6 x 43 size: no page I could open lists it. Removed the note that Cigar Aficionado rated some Medium-Full: not found on any CA page opened. Dropped 'pricier, larger-ring' from about (price not checked). Replaced the luxurycigarclub source (its sizes, 5x52 and 4.75x50, do not match CA or Famous Smoke) with the Famous Smoke Scepter page. Confirmed: Ecuador wrapper, USA Connecticut Shade binder, Dominican and Peruvian filler, Dominican Republic (CA); Connecticut Shade wrapper leaf (Famous Smoke); 2002 launch (halfwheel, two articles); Crown Chubby Especial 5 7/8 x 61 (CA ratings/5526). filler: Dominican Republic (San Vicente and San Vicente Mejorado Seco), Honduras (Olancho and Jamastran Viso), Nicaragua (Ometepe Viso)
about: Zino Nicaragua is the value-priced relaunch of Davidoff's Zino brand from 2021. Despite the name it is rolled in Honduras at Davidoff's Diadema factory, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder and a three-country filler.
notes: Rolled in Honduras, not Nicaragua, and it is not a Nicaraguan puro. The maker's line page says medium strength (intensity 3 of 5), though its home page calls it bold and full-bodied; halfwheel found medium body and strength. The Half Corona comes pre-cut with a punch.
